announcements.title: Keep Aniraku online
announcements.banner: Backend credit ends ~October 19–20. When it runs out, streaming stops — Aniraku is free, open-source, and runs on donations alone.
body: Our backend credit runs out around October 19–20. When it's gone, streaming stops — the app still opens, but playback goes dark until the servers are topped up.
Aniraku already has a huge library, and it's growing fast — we add titles as quickly as you ask for them.

Aniraku is free, open-source, and has no ads and no paid tier. It's built and run by one person from a middle-class family — no company, no investors, and no personal money left to keep the servers on. Donations are the only thing keeping Aniraku alive.
If Aniraku has saved you time, a small donation keeps it online past October 20. Every bit helps — and thank you for watching with us.
